_doc:
STRUCTURE (verified on all 10 bills, account [number removed], Oct-2025..Aug-2026). ONE account, ONE property (ERF 11784 000, Tulbagh Street 23, Worcester Ou-Dorp1), ONE electricity meter ([number removed]) and ONE water meter (CPJA2363U) per PDF. The whole statement is PDF page 1 ('Page 1 of 1'). The 183,000-199,000 char raw text is NOT many properties and NOT a tariff appendix: PDF page 2 is the printed reverse side (bilingual terms/conditions) which PyMuPDF sort=True renders as ~176,000 chars of whitespace-padded word soup (single lines up to 58,000 chars). One bill ([number removed]) additionally carries a 2-page municipal newsletter insert (pages 3-4). So NO block_anchor / per-meter rows are needed - one electricity row per PDF is correct - but every section MUST be bounded so the page-2 soup is never in scope. That is what the rules-free 'sundry' section at REMITTANCE ADVICE is for: it is a pure boundary that terminates the electricity section before the first \f. No rule uses 'document' scope for the same reason.
LAYOUT. Header (above METER READINGS) holds TAX INVOICE NO / ACCOUNT NUMBER (prefixed 'WMUN ') / ACCOUNT DATE / RECEIPTS POSTED TO / DEBTOR VAT NUMBER and the PROPERTY INFORMATION column (ERF, STREET ADDRESS, SUBURB). Then a METER READINGS table with one line per service letter: W = water (kL), E = electricity energy (kWh), K = electricity maximum demand (kVA). Columns are SERVICE / METER NO. / PREVIOUS READING / NEW READING / UNITS / PERIOD; the K line prints NOTHING in PREVIOUS READING (its single reading sits in the NEW READING column, cols 66-73) so its pattern must expect one reading, not two. PERIOD is printed DD/MM-DD/MM with NO YEAR - read_start/read_end are therefore kept exactly as printed ('01/07', '01/08'), per the 'date == as printed' rule.
Then a charges table SERVICE TYPE / TARIFF / CONSUMPTION / VAT / CHARGE / AMOUNT, with THREE electricity lines: 'ELEC./ELEK.  LPUE' (energy, has a CONSUMPTION value), 'ELEC./ELEK.  LPUS' (service/basic charge, NO consumption - only 3 money columns) and 'Electricity  KVA  LPUDM' (demand). CHARGE is EX VAT and is printed with FIVE decimals (152300.64000); AMOUNT is INC VAT (= CHARGE + VAT) with two. The energy and service-charge lines are told apart STRUCTURALLY (4 numeric columns vs 3), not by tariff code, so a code change cannot silently drop the energy line.
SINGLE-BAND TARIFF. LPU is a flat energy tariff - no TOU. Following the CoJ-flat / Ekurhuleni convention the single energy band is routed to STANDARD; peak_* and offpeak_* are '_none'. NMD is never printed -> '_none'. Deposit/cash/guarantee/security are never printed (the DEPOSIT label exists in the header but is always blank) -> '_none'.
RULE ZERO. The bill prints NO independent ex-VAT electricity total, so total_ex_vat_r == sum(energy + service + demand CHARGE) and reconcile is STRUCTURALLY CIRCULAR - do not read it as a check. The genuine checks are (a) bv_elec_vat_r + bv_water_vat_r == the printed TOTAL VAT figure (independently captured from the AGREEMENT block), and (b) end reading - start reading == the printed UNITS == the charges-table CONSUMPTION (three independent prints of total kWh).
READING TYPE. The electricity (E) line prints no A/E flag on any of the 10 bills; the water (W) line always prints 'E' and the header note 'your usage for this month has been Estimated' belongs to water (water increments a flat 24-26 kL/month, electricity increments realistically). Electricity reading_type is therefore DERIVED as 'Actual' by label_present when no estimate flag is present - an inference, flagged here deliberately.
RECON. prev_balance ('Balance brought forward'), incoming_payment ('Receipts:', trailing minus), vat (printed TOTAL VAT), total_due ('AMOUNT DUE') and due_date are all printed and mapped. current_ex is deliberately LEFT BLANK: BVM prints no current-charges total. '** Total monthly', 'CURRENT' and 'AMOUNT DUE' are all the CLOSING BALANCE (opening balance + receipts + this month's charges) - on [number removed] the AGREEMENT row reads ARREARS 319.64 / CURRENT 222947.80 / AMOUNT DUE 223267.44, i.e. CURRENT is a balance-aging split, not the month's charges. Mapping it to current_incl would have put a balance into a charges column (and doubled it into Accrual), so it is omitted. The only honest current-charges figure is the SUM of the CHARGE column across services, which a single-capture recon regex cannot express.
FINGERPRINT. Breede Valley's own municipal VAT registration 4850193659 (printed 'VAT / BTW : 4850193659'), plus its Worcester private bag and bvm.gov.za. NOT the CBRE recipient address - [address removed] appears on these bills and is what made them hijack the mangaung profile. 4680101146 on these bills is the DEBTOR's (Telkom's) VAT number, not the municipality's - never fingerprint on that.
